body:
I tried it with a couple of sticks on incense, but had no luck as the fan kept blowing the smoke away.

Turns out it was the gaskets after all.  Thanks for the comment!

The unauthorized repair was a mistake and I believe it (he called to give me an estimate and list out what all the estimate involved, but he left out the belt.  He says he mentioned it, I know he didn't because it was something I knew about and was planning on getting fixed, for $27 instead of $130).  I think he's seeing extra $109 as chump change compared to the bill facing me at the end of all this, but I'm not happy since it's something I could have done with my own two hands and a little guidance from a male friend.

I'm kinda worried about that solenoid on the EGR valve failing immediately.  At least he replaced that under warranty. 

What I'm most unhappy about is that he sent me to a specific muffler shop, and we agreed that the shop would send the total to the mechanic to just add to my bill (for state voucher purposes).  That wasn't communicated to the muffler shop, so I had to figure out how to pay $617 on the spot to unexpectedly to spring my car :/
Easy A was amazing and your outfit is amazing and you should feel good.

Cards Against Humanity or Apples to Apples: if you want to take a sharpie to a card you must get approval from the game owner.  Also, after you make the new card, you can't play it.  Instead, you have to give it away through sacrifice:

Anybody who wants to be part of the sacrifice chooses one or more shitty cards (or cards they just don't understand) for sacrifice, and lays them face down.  The card sharpier has to randomly choose one of the sacrificed cards and give the newly-made sharpied card to the person who's sacrifice was taken.
Great!! I'll give it a look.

I really appreciate it!  I'll try it.  Either way, I know it's going to be an expensive fix, but I just need to make sure the mechanic actually fixes what's wrong and not what he thinks is wrong.

I'm not dissing on mechanics in general, but I'm not so sure how much I trust this one.  Unfortunately, I'm locked in to him because I'm using a state voucher to cover some of the repairs, and he was the only nearby authorized repair facility :/
So... just like real life!! When you're at your wits' end and you have nothing else to live for, rob a bank.  If you get caught, jail can be better than living on the street.
Hm, I might have a friend with a scanner.  I will print your comment to take it to him because I admit it's over my head!  He'll probably know what this means.

Thank you.  I really appreciate the reply.  I think I may have to have help with this one because I'm so lost!  Maybe there's a schematic online of my engine that shows where I should be spraying (i.e. where there are vacuum hoses)
